relations.subject: Karma Lekshe Tsomo
relations.evidence: In that year, along with Ven. Ayya Khema, Dr. Chatsumarn Kabilsingh, and others, I organized the first International Conference on Buddhist Nuns in Bodhgaya... an International Association of Buddhist Women called Sakyadhita... was established.

relations.subject: Ayya Khema
relations.evidence: The initial impetus grew from a dream spun by Ayya Khema, Chatsumarn Kabilsingh, and myself, in 1986... along with Ven. Ayya Khema, Dr. Chatsumarn Kabilsingh, and others, I organized the first International Conference... Sakyadhita... was established.
